narrative:
Allen County has 63,986 registered voters, with 12.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 32.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 50.5%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 18.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.7% of registrants.
